summary: Prepare standalone public-service tags through the existing release tool
details: Route usdb-public-vX.Y.Z releases to USDB only, without requiring SourceDAO or reading and updating the Go compatibility lock; node release preparation retains its coordinated scope.
Require a clean USDB master matching origin/master, the canonical origin, tracked public release entry points and a matching public network catalog before creating the annotated tag.
Retain explicit create and push flags and reject existing local or remote tags; a failed push preserves the local tag and reports how to push that exact tag again.
Document the independent tag-triggered Public CI and build pipeline, draft publication and separate assets within the shared GitHub Releases list.
